findings.location: apps/cli/config.cpp:86 (and 132, 152, 156, 193, 213); apps/cli has no exception handling
findings.configuration: a configuration file with the schema and the command but without the required inputs: {"schema":"acsd.config/2","command":"normalize"}; run acsd normalize --json config.json
findings.expected: exit code 2 with a JSONL event stream and result.code, as declared in API.md (exit 2 for an invalid configuration) and brief section 2 (no exception as protocol)
findings.actual: an uncaught nlohmann::json out_of_range (key 'inputs' not found) terminates the process with SIGABRT, exit code 134, no event stream on stdout
findings.fix: use the checked accessors in the configuration decoder and return a decoding failure; wrap the command entry in a try/catch that maps the exception to exit 2 with the event envelope

findings.configuration: a NoiseModel with two shared_factors entries with the same shared_id, the same factor (the 2x2 identity) and the same influence R = [1, 1]; the functional is t = [1]
findings.expected: the total influence of the same shared root is formed first and applied once: (2R)(2R)^T = 8, as required by API.md (same shared root is merged before the total influence) and STATISTICS_SKY_COADD.md line 32 (one propagation with J_xi Cov(xi) J_xi^T)
findings.actual: quadratic_form returns 4 (the two entries are applied as independent roots, the cross term of the same source is lost); the independent driver prints 'case B the same shared root twice: value 4 expected 8'
findings.fix: merge the shared factors with the same shared_id into one root whose influence is the sum, and apply the merged root once

findings.location: validation/run_summary.json (produced by the run) and apps/contract/driver.cpp:1412 (the operation whitelist)
findings.configuration: python3 validation/run_all.py over the eleven cases required by the VERIFICATION matrix
findings.expected: every case of the required matrix is executed and compared against its frozen truth
findings.actual: C01, G01 and U01 pass; F01 fails (fit_psf design matrix rank deficient, outside the audited scope); S01, W01, V01, E01, P01, R01 and X01 are pending_implementation because the contract driver does not implement the sky, coadd, information, workflow and publication operations although the production entry points exist
findings.fix: extend the operation whitelist of apps/contract (or add the native drivers and wire them into validation/run_all.py) so the seven cases can reach the public API

findings.location: src/uncertainty/api.cpp (the shared root consistency check compares unit.multiplier only)
findings.configuration: two shared roots with the same shared_id, the same multiplier 1.0 and different unit scales (fixture:L and other:L)
findings.actual: make_covariance returns ok (code 0); the two units are mixed and the variance unit loses its meaning
findings.fix: compare the whole Unit (scale, the powers and the multiplier)

findings.location: src/information/information.cpp:350-358 (the rank is classified on the Gram matrix)
findings.configuration: estimate_flux_information with a design whose singular value ratio is 1e-8, between the declared 1e-12 and 1e-6
findings.expected: the rank_relative threshold acts on the singular values of the design (EXECUTION: rank_relative=1e-12 is the classification threshold)
findings.actual: the Gram matrix carries the squared singular values, so the effective threshold on the design is 1e-6; a genuinely estimable mode is reported as unestimable
findings.fix: classify the rank on the whitened or reduced matrix and keep the Gram only for the projection

findings.location: src/workflows/product_io.cpp (the block reading path of open_product)
findings.configuration: delete one block file of a published product and open it in a fresh process
findings.expected: Code::missing_dependency (API.md: a missing closure is missing_dependency)
findings.actual: Code::io_error; the caller cannot distinguish an incomplete closure from a disk failure
findings.fix: separate the absent file from the unreadable file; keep hash_mismatch for a block whose content does not match

findings.expected: stdout carries one JSON object per line (API.md: stdout is the JSONL event stream)
findings.actual: the doctor writes a multi line pretty printed object between the two events, so a line by line JSON reader of the GUI fails
findings.fix: write the diagnostic to stderr or as a single line event

findings.expected: the run_summary lists the input, published, unsolved, failed and cancelled counters and the per frame statuses (API.md)
findings.actual: the summary only carries {"version":"2.0.0"}; the doctor branch builds the full summary

findings.location: src/workflows/mosaic.cpp and src/workflows/export_workflow.cpp (no cancellation check; only src/workflows/normalize.cpp:258,547 has one)
findings.configuration: write {"protocol":"acsd.control/2","command":"cancel","run_id":...} to stdin during a long mosaic or export
findings.expected: the run stops at a safe boundary and exits with code 5 (API.md: the cancel is a named termination)
findings.actual: these paths have no cancellation point, so the cancellation is only observed inside normalize
findings.fix: add the cancellation check to the per frame loop of mosaic and the per block loop of export

cli_event_schema.exception: the doctor command writes a multi line object to stdout

not_run: R01: the scientific content identity under one and four threads, the spill at a low memory budget, the cancellation and the write failure
X01: the three commands over a real disk product with an independent blind solve
S01, W01, V01, E01, P01: the observed side of the required cases
the GUI process itself: only the protocol and the schema were checked
observations: cfitsio 4.6.2 is available (reported by acsd doctor) but the FITS reader and writer are hand written; the writer is verified by an independent reader for a single tile only, the E01 case is pending

during the audit the shared working tree briefly failed the whole build because tools/generate_contract_schema.py could not parse the Box declaration while another agent was editing; the state was not reproducible and is not counted as a finding
